# Spring Store Report

Our team checked every store in March. Most stores met the new goal, and two stores beat it by a wide margin. The table below shows the numbers for each region.

## Sales by region

| Region | Stores | Sales |
| --- | --- | --- |
| North | 12 | $48,200 |
| South | 9 | $39,950 |
| West | 15 | $61,300 |

## Next steps

- Hire two new staff in the West region.
- Fix the slow checkout in South stores.
- Check again in June.

## Notes

Sales numbers are before tax. Two stores in the North opened late, so they only count for half the month. Ask the store lead if a number looks wrong.
